facts.fact: A World Bank-linked consultant writes that the national validation workshop for Seychelles' National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031, which covers responsible AI adoption, concluded in the two weeks before 10 July 2026; no adoption is stated.

SYC.note: The strategy lists digital skills as a theme; no civil service training is stated.
The strategy lists digital skills as a theme; no programme or measured share is stated.

facts.fact: A consultant on the team drafting Seychelles' National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031 says the national validation workshop concluded in the two weeks before 10 July 2026, with no adoption stated; the strategy covers digital infrastructure, government services, AI, skills, innovation and the digital economy.
The strategy under development is titled National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031, per the consultant's post of 10 July 2026.

SYC.note: No ICT or telecommunications sector policy is described.
No open data policy is stated.

facts.fact: A consultant on the drafting team says the Seychelles National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031 followed consultations with public institutions, the private sector, academia, civil society and development partners, and a national validation workshop concluded in the two weeks before 10 July 2026.
